title: Ficta Schema File
description: JSON Schema for ficta.schema.json files used by generateFromSchemaFile(). Defines multi-table test-data generation with optional per-table row counts and FK references.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for IDE autocompletion.

tables.description: Ordered list of tables to generate. Tables with FK dependencies are sorted internally.

defaultRows.description: Default number of rows to generate for each table when the table does not specify its own 'rows'. Falls back to 100 if omitted.

dialect.description: SQL dialect used for DDL and DML generation. Defaults to 'generic'.

name.description: Table name as it will appear in the generated SQL.

rows.description: Number of rows to generate for this table. Overrides 'defaultRows'.

sqlType.description: Override SQL type emitted in CREATE TABLE DDL (e.g. 'VARCHAR(100)').

primaryKey.description: Whether this column is part of the primary key.

nullable.description: When false, adds NOT NULL to the column definition.

unique.description: When true, adds UNIQUE to the column definition.

default.description: Default value for the column in the generated DDL.

references.description: Foreign key reference to another table's column.
